# `cfmat.automation`

<!-- generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py; do not edit -->

Automation and monitoring: the signal service and trade journal used by n8n, and live monitoring (M18).

```text
    journal_store    SQLite trade journal
    signal_service   HTTP endpoints (run ``python -m cfmat.automation.signal_service``)
    monitoring       heartbeats, stale feeds, live-vs-backtest drift, P&L attribution, alert rules

``signal_service`` is not imported here so that ``python -m`` runs it cleanly.
```

### `cfmat.automation.journal_store`

SQLite trade journal used by the signal service and the n8n workflows (M18).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `init_journal` | `def init_journal(db_path: str \| Path) -> None` | Create the journal table if it does not exist. |
| `insert_fill` | `def insert_fill(db_path: str \| Path, payload: dict) -> int` | Store one fill and return the new row count. |
| `recent_fills` | `def recent_fills(db_path: str \| Path, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]` | The newest ``limit`` journal rows, newest first. |

### `cfmat.automation.monitoring`

Live monitoring for a trading process: heartbeats, stale data, drift, P&L attribution and alerts (M18).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Alert` | `class Alert(ts: pd.Timestamp, rule: str, severity: str, status: str, value: float, message: str) -> None` | One notification: ``status`` is firing, reminder or resolved. |
| `AlertManager` | `class AlertManager(rules: list[AlertRule], sinks: list[Callable[[Alert], None]] = <factory>) -> None` | Evaluate rules on each batch of metrics, de-duplicate, and deliver alerts to ``sinks``. |
| `AlertManager.evaluate` | `evaluate(self, metrics: dict[str, float], now) -> list[Alert]` | Check every rule against ``metrics`` at time ``now``; returns the alerts sent. |
| `AlertManager.history_frame` | `history_frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame` | Every alert sent so far, one row each. |
| `AlertRule` | `class AlertRule(name: str, metric: str, op: str, threshold: float, severity: str = 'warning', cooldown: str = '15min', message: str = '{name}: {metric} = {value:.4g} (rule: {op} {threshold:g})') -> None` | Fire when ``metric`` ``op`` ``threshold`` holds, at most once per ``cooldown`` while it lasts. |
| `AlertRule.breached` | `breached(self, value: float) -> bool` | True when the value breaks the rule (missing values never do). |
| `drift_report` | `def drift_report(live_returns: pd.Series, backtest_returns: pd.Series, live_signals: pd.Series \| None = None, backtest_signals: pd.Series \| None = None, fills: pd.DataFrame \| None = None, expected_slippage_bps: float = 0.0, alpha: float = 0.01, min_agreement: float = 0.95) -> pd.Series` | Is live (or paper) trading still the strategy that was backtested? |
| `heartbeat_gaps` | `def heartbeat_gaps(beats: Iterable, every: str = '10s', tolerance: float = 3.0, start: str \| pd.Timestamp \| None = None, end: str \| pd.Timestamp \| None = None) -> pd.DataFrame` | Silences longer than ``tolerance`` × ``every`` in a process's heartbeat. |
| `pnl_attribution` | `def pnl_attribution(trades: pd.DataFrame, closes: pd.Series \| pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame` | Daily P&L split into signal, execution and costs; the three add up to the true P&L. |
| `staleness` | `def staleness(updates: pd.DataFrame, check_every: str = '5s', max_age: str = '30s', frozen_after: str = '30s', min_updates: int = 5, session: tuple[str, str] = ('09:15', '15:30')) -> pd.DataFrame` | Feed checks on a timer, per symbol: ``no_updates`` or ``frozen`` incidents. |
| `webhook_sink` | `def webhook_sink(url: str, timeout: float = 5.0) -> Callable[[Alert], None]` | A sink that POSTs each alert as JSON to ``url`` (for example an n8n webhook). |

### `cfmat.automation.signal_service`

Tiny HTTP service that the n8n workflows call (M18).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `compute_signal` | `def compute_signal(symbol: str, fast: int = 20, slow: int = 50) -> dict` | Latest SMA-crossover signal for ``symbol`` with the action it implies (enter, exit, hold, stay flat). |
| `load_close` | `def load_close(symbol: str) -> pd.Series` | Closing prices for ``symbol``: the learner's CSV if present, else synthetic. |
| `main` | `def main(argv: list[str] \| None = None) -> None` | Command-line entry point: ``python -m cfmat.automation.signal_service --port 8000``. |
| `make_handler` | `def make_handler(db_path: str \| Path)` | Build the HTTP request handler class bound to the journal at ``db_path``. |
| `make_server` | `def make_server(host: str = '127.0.0.1', port: int = 8000, db_path: str \| Path = 'trade_journal.sqlite') -> ThreadingHTTPServer` | Create the journal if needed and return a threaded HTTP server (call ``serve_forever``). |
